name: CALL2M
notes: National 2 m FM simplex calling. ARRL simplex segments: 146.40-146.58, 147.42-147.57 (also 144.90-145.10). Alaska ARES guide lists 146.52 as 2 m calling for the (HF) Bush Net.

name: CALL70
notes: National 70 cm FM simplex frequency (ARRL: 445-447 local option simplex/links). Alaska ARES guide lists 446.00 as 70 cm calling for the Motley Net.
